description: This PHP source file defines the class GenericBasicDisplayField, which extends BasicDisplayField. It contains a constant mapping of display field aliases to their corresponding entity and field names, and methods to set and retrieve entity and field information based on display field aliases. The class is part of a reporting system within the Human Resource Management system of OrangeHRM, possibly used to dynamically generate report display fields.

classes.name: GenericBasicDisplayField
classes.description: Represents a basic display field for reports with mapping and setter/getter methods for entity and field details.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets the entity alias and field based on the display field's alias using a predefined mapping.

methods.name: getEntityAlias
methods.description: Returns the entity alias associated with this display field.

methods.name: setEntityAlias
methods.description: Sets the entity alias internal state.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns the database field name associated with this display field.

methods.name: setField
methods.description: Sets the field name internal state.
